text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
BULKERS - Annet Maritimer - (built 1973) 53,948 dwt sold to Norwegian buyers for $3.1 million.
Captain Sarantis - (built 1975) 53,293 dwt sold to Chinese buyers for $2.2 million.
Iro - (built 1976) 30,817 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $3.4 million.
Eurus - (built 1988) 139,764 dwt sold to Norwegian buyers for $75 million "enbloc" with timecharter.
Venita - (built 1980) 87,561 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $9 million on subjects.
REEFERS - White Mountain - (built 1983) 8,160 dwt sold to Norwegian buyers for $7.5 million.
SOLD FOR DEMOLITION - Osman Azmi - (built 1972) 118,159 dwt sold to Middle Eastern buyers for $160 per ldt "as is".
Forum Trader - (built 1974) 67,807 dwt sold to Indian breakers for $170 per ldt.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to inspection, survey or other conditions.
